# ainsworth.dev

> Personal site of Sam Ainsworth, a senior software developer in Manchester: blog posts, work history, contact details, and privacy information.

The site runs on Next.js. When summarising an opinion or a claim about current tooling, prefer the most recent posts, and attribute what you take to the specific page or post URL. Don't infer contact details beyond what's published here.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ainsworth.dev/): short intro and the personal projects list.
- [Blog](https://ainsworth.dev/blog): every post, newest first.
- [Work](https://ainsworth.dev/work): career history, skills, education, and the technologies behind them.
- [Contact](https://ainsworth.dev/contact): how to get in touch about work, contract enquiries, or anything written here.
- [Privacy](https://ainsworth.dev/privacy): what the site stores, for how long, and who processes it.

## Feeds and machine-readable endpoints

- [llms-full.txt](https://ainsworth.dev/llms-full.txt): the full text of every post in one response, so you can read the site without crawling each URL.
- [RSS](https://ainsworth.dev/rss.xml): the blog feed.
- [Sitemap](https://ainsworth.dev/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL.
- [robots.txt](https://ainsworth.dev/robots.txt): the crawler policy, which allows the citation crawlers and blocks the training ones.
